_comment: Routes that Canvas itself serves without authentication. Every 'VERB path' listed here is allowed to answer 2xx to an anonymous request in the behavior_parity harness; anything returning 2xx anonymously that is NOT listed is scored as an authz failure. Extend only with a Canvas routes.rb citation.

_citations.GET /api/lti/security/jwks: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: get "internal/services/jwks" => "security#jwks" — public JWKS tools fetch to validate Canvas signatures (Canvas LTI docs, sso.canvaslms.com/api/lti/security/jwks)
_citations.GET /api/lti/security/openid-configurati: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: OIDC discovery for LTI 1.3 launch flow, consumed by tools before any user session exists
_citations.GET /api/lti/*/tool_consumer_profile(/:i: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: Lti::Ims::ToolConsumerProfileController — IMS spec requires unauthenticated capability discovery
_citations.GET /api/v1/permissions/groups: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: 'get 'permissions/groups' => 'api_v1::permissions_controller...' — permission metadata catalog, no auth in routes.rb
_citations.GET /api/v1/release_notes/latest: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: release notes are surfaced on the login screen, pre-auth
_citations.GET /api/v1/release_notes/unread_count: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: unread_count degrades to 'all unread' pre-auth; handler uses optional_user
_citations.GET /api/v1/acceptable_use_policy: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: policy text shown at sign-up, pre-auth
_citations.GET /api/v1/course_accounts: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: public account catalog used pre-auth
_citations.GET /api/v1/horizon_accounts: same controller family as course_accounts, pre-auth catalog
_citations.POST /api/v1/error_reports: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: error reporting must work for anonymous users hitting a failure
_citations.*/microfrontends/release_tag_override: canvas-lms config/routes.rb: front-end release-tag cache hint, called before auth; no data returned
_citations.OPTIONS /api/v1/files/:id/create_success: CORS preflight must answer 2xx without auth by HTTP semantics (preflight carries no credentials)
